regions.today: This morning, rain will move southeastwards over Leinster, heavy at times with localised flooding possible. It will become confined to the south by noon, where it will persist for the rest of the day. Becoming drier elsewhere with some sunny intervals and a few showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight, rain in the south and southwest will clear. It will be a mainly dry night with a fair amount of cloud, some clear spells and a few showers. Patches of mist and fog will form. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees with light, variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will be mainly dry with a fair amount of cloud and some bright or sunny intervals and perhaps a few isolated showers. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees, warmest in the southeast with light variable or southerly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate in sunshine today and Sunday
